templates.employee_summary: Your company will typically sponsor an Employment Pass (EP) or S Pass depending on role and salary. ReloPass tracks documents and milestones so HR and you stay aligned before the move.
templates.hr_summary: Standard path: verify quota/salary benchmarks, obtain EP or S Pass approval via MOM, then complete issuance and relocation steps. Timeline compresses if dependants need passes.
templates.internal_notes_hr: Confirm COMPASS / Fair Consideration where applicable; check DP needs early.
watchouts: EP processing can take several weeks; start once salary and role classification are firm.
Dependant passes add parallel documentation (marriage/birth certificates, translations).
IPA validity window is tight — align travel and entry dates with HR.

checklist.title: Signed employment contract & job description
checklist.notes_employee: Your HR team provides these for the pass application.
checklist.notes_hr: Ensure JD matches MOM role classification.

checklist.title: Passport bio page (all travellers)
checklist.notes_employee: Valid for at least 6 months beyond intended entry.

checklist.title: Educational certificates & transcripts
checklist.notes_employee: May require certified translations.

checklist.title: Company EP application submission
checklist.notes_employee: Handled by HR or immigration partner.

checklist.title: In-Principle Approval (IPA) received
checklist.notes_employee: You will need IPA for entry when instructed.

checklist.title: Medical examination (if required)
checklist.notes_employee: Clinic list usually provided with IPA.

checklist.title: Issue pass & register fingerprints
checklist.notes_employee: Completed after arrival in Singapore.

checklist.title: Housing & schooling shortlist (if family)
checklist.notes_employee: Parallel track to immigration.

milestones.title: Kickoff & route confirmation
milestones.body_employee: HR confirms the sponsored pass route and timeline with you.
milestones.body_hr: Lock salary band, role title, and dependency on EP vs S Pass.

milestones.title: Document pack complete
milestones.body_employee: You upload passport, education, and family documents as requested.

milestones.title: MOM submission
milestones.body_employee: Handled by employer; you may be asked for clarifications.
milestones.body_hr: Submit EP/S Pass application; monitor status.

milestones.title: IPA issued
milestones.body_employee: Review entry instructions and validity dates.
milestones.body_hr: Share IPA; plan entry and pass issuance appointment.

milestones.title: Enter Singapore & complete pass formalities
milestones.body_employee: Follow IPA conditions; attend appointment if required.

milestones.title: Settle-in & local registrations
milestones.body_employee: Bank, phone, housing handover as applicable.

templates.route_title: France — Salarié / passeport talent (high-level typical paths)
templates.employee_summary: France offers several sponsored work routes; your employer’s immigration partner usually selects between standard employee permits or talent passports depending on role and compensation.
templates.hr_summary: Validate work authorization path with counsel; long-stay visa + titre de séjour sequence applies for most non-EU nationals. Lead times vary by consulate.
templates.internal_notes_hr: Talent passport eligibility reduces some steps — confirm with legal.
watchouts: Consulate appointment availability can be the critical path.
Medical visit (OFII) and titre appointments are sequential — do not skip ordering.
Housing proof may be needed early for some visa types.

checklist.title: Work contract & assignment letter
checklist.notes_hr: French or certified translation as required.

checklist.title: Police clearance / casier (if requested)
checklist.notes_employee: Depends on consulate checklist.

checklist.title: Long-stay visa application
checklist.notes_employee: Book consulate appointment when HR confirms pack.
checklist.notes_hr: Track VLS-TS vs other visa types.

checklist.title: Arrival declaration & medical (OFII)
checklist.notes_employee: Follow instructions stamped in passport.

checklist.title: Titre de séjour appointment
checklist.notes_employee: Prefecture scheduling varies by location.

checklist.title: Social security & bank setup
checklist.notes_employee: Often after titre issuance.

checklist.title: Housing lease or temporary accommodation proof
checklist.notes_hr: May be required for some steps.

milestones.title: Route & counsel alignment
milestones.body_employee: HR explains expected permit path and timing.

milestones.title: Arrival in France
milestones.body_employee: Start visa validation / OFII steps as instructed.

templates.route_title: United Kingdom — Skilled Worker visa (sponsored route)
templates.employee_summary: Your employer holds a sponsor licence and will assign you a Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS). You then apply for a Skilled Worker visa before travelling to the UK. ReloPass tracks each step so nothing slips.
templates.hr_summary: Confirm sponsor licence is active, assign an undefined or defined CoS as appropriate, and support the employee's visa application. Right-to-work check on Day 1 is mandatory.
templates.internal_notes_hr: Check CoS assignment lead time (defined CoS needs Home Office approval, ~5 business days). Ensure salary meets minimum threshold for role SOC code. BRP collection from Post Office within 10 days of arrival.
watchouts: CoS must be assigned before the employee submits their visa application — allow at least 1 week buffer.
Salary must meet both the general threshold and the specific SOC code going rate; verify before issuing CoS.
BRP card is sent to a UK address — employee must collect within 10 days of arrival.
Right-to-work check must be completed on or before Day 1; share code expires in 90 days.

checklist.title: Formal offer letter confirming role, salary & SOC code
checklist.notes_employee: Required for CoS assignment and visa application.
checklist.notes_hr: Salary must satisfy both general threshold and going rate for the SOC code.

checklist.title: Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) assigned
checklist.notes_employee: You will need the CoS reference number to apply for your visa.
checklist.notes_hr: Use undefined CoS for most new hires; defined CoS if employee is already in UK on another route.

checklist.title: Valid passport (all travellers)
checklist.notes_employee: Must be valid for the duration of your intended stay.

checklist.title: English language evidence
checklist.notes_employee: Degree taught in English, or approved test (IELTS/LanguageCert). Check UKVI approved providers.
checklist.notes_hr: Exempt if national of majority English-speaking country.

checklist.title: Maintenance funds evidence (if not covered by employer)
checklist.notes_employee: £1,270 in bank for 28 consecutive days unless employer certifies maintenance.
checklist.notes_hr: Certify maintenance on CoS to remove this requirement for the employee.

checklist.title: Online visa application submitted & biometrics booked
checklist.notes_employee: Apply at least 3 months before start date. Biometrics at UKVCAS service point.
checklist.notes_hr: Provide IHS surcharge payment confirmation number if employer covers it.

checklist.title: Skilled Worker visa granted
checklist.notes_employee: Check vignette dates — first entry must be on or before the valid from date.
checklist.notes_hr: Retain copy for sponsor compliance file.

checklist.title: Right-to-work check completed (Day 1)
checklist.notes_employee: Use the UKVI online share code to allow HR to verify.
checklist.notes_hr: Statutory excuse requires online check for visa nationals — record date and outcome.

checklist.title: BRP card collected from Post Office
checklist.notes_employee: Collect within 10 days of arrival. Address on visa letter shows which Post Office branch.
checklist.notes_hr: Retain copy for compliance file; chase if not confirmed collected.

checklist.title: Housing & schooling shortlist (if family)
checklist.notes_employee: Dependant visas can be applied at the same time.
checklist.notes_hr: Confirm whether employer covers relocation costs.

milestones.title: Kickoff & sponsorship check
milestones.body_employee: HR confirms your employer is a licensed sponsor and outlines the Skilled Worker timeline.
milestones.body_hr: Verify sponsor licence is active, check CoS allocation, confirm salary vs SOC code thresholds.

milestones.title: CoS assigned
milestones.body_employee: You receive your CoS reference number — keep it safe for the visa application.
milestones.body_hr: Assign CoS via sponsor management system; note expiry (3 months from assignment).

milestones.title: Document pack ready
milestones.body_employee: Gather passport, English evidence, finances (if needed), and any dependant documents.
milestones.body_hr: Review pack for completeness before employee submits application.

milestones.title: Visa application submitted & biometrics
milestones.body_employee: Submit online, pay IHS surcharge, attend biometrics appointment.
milestones.body_hr: Confirm IHS paid (or reimbursed per policy); track application reference.

milestones.title: Visa decision received
milestones.body_employee: Check vignette validity. First entry before 'valid from' date.
milestones.body_hr: File decision copy; update compliance record.

milestones.title: Arrival in UK & right-to-work check
milestones.body_employee: Generate share code; HR will complete the online check on Day 1.
milestones.body_hr: Complete UKVI online right-to-work check on or before start date.

milestones.title: BRP collected & settle-in
milestones.body_employee: Collect BRP within 10 days. Start bank account, NI number, GP registration.
milestones.body_hr: Confirm BRP collected; file copy; schedule 6-month compliance check.
